description: Experience ultimate audio with the CARNIwAL 717 Soundbar. Boasting 50W RMS output and powerful drivers, this Bluetooth soundbar delivers deep, immersive sound for music, movies, and parties. Enjoy up to 8 hours of nonstop playtime, enhanced with dynamic RGB lights for a visual treat. The TWS function allows pairing multiple units for a wider stereo experience, while built-in FM radio, call functionality, and multiple connectivity options make it your all-in-one entertainment companion. With 3 EQ modes, control your audio experience effortlessly. Compact, stylish, and packed with features - CARNIwAL 717 redefines sound.
